COEP Technological University Pune 
Instructions to Candidates for Reporting and Confirmation of Admission AY-2026-27 
 
Preparation Before Coming to the Admission Process at COEP Tech 
a. If you are accepting seat allotted by CET-CELL through CAP Round, FREEZE the SEAT 
ALLOTTED through candidate’s LOGIN on CET-CELL portal. 
b. Prepare the Demand Draft (DD) of appropriate amount of FEES as applicable to your Category 
for Admission (As printed on Acknowledgement Letter received after Scrutiny). Refer FEES 
Structure on next page for AY 2026-27, also available on COEP Tech website. Demand Draft 
should be drawn in favor of “COEP Technological University” payable at Pune. No partial 
payment is permitted. Write following on Backside of DD: (Fees Accepted only through DD) 
1. Candidate Name       2. Mobile No.        3. Application ID (EN26XX)         4. Branch Allotted 
c. Prepare TWO SETS of Photocopies of all documents that you have uploaded to CET Cell 
Portal. and bring ALL necessary Original Documents along with Original Leaving 
Certificate. 
 TWO Recent Passport Size COLOUR photographs of candidate. 
  Original Living Certificate and all necessary original documents 
 If you are already admitted to another Institute/University, kindly bring Original Admission 
Letter indicating list of original documents submitted and Fee Receipt issued by that 
institute. 
 
Steps for Admission Process 
Reporting Time: 9.00 AM to 5.00 PM, on all days of Reporting. 
1. Report to Venue: 1st Floor, Main-Auditorium, South Campus, COEP Tech, Pune. 
2. Collect your Admission Process KIT: At the Entrance of Main-Auditorium, show Demand 
Draft (DD) of Fees and collect the Admission Process KIT. And Fill ALL the forms provided in 
the KIT. 
3. At Counter No.1: Submit DD and collect the fee receipt. 
4. At Counter No. 2: Verify All-ORIGINAL Documents (which are uploaded to CET-CELL Portal) 
and confirm the admission. 
5. At Counter No. 3: Submit ALL necessary ORIGINAL Documents. 
6. At Counter No. 4: Register Entry and Collect Admission Acknowledgement Receipt. 
 
Your Admission Process is Completed! #- Welcome To COEP Tech.-# 
 

 For Hostel admission: Online Application Form and related Information visit following link 
https://www.coeptech.ac.in/hostel/hostel-admissions/
